label: Bible Study
prompt: Thou shalt not bear _____ witness against thy neighbour.
verse: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
note: 'Bear false witness' is courtroom language — but the commandment covers the backyard fence too.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For God is not unrighteous to _____ your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verse: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
note: God isn't forgetful about your quiet acts of love — every kindness to His people is remembered.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and _____ write unto thee:
verse: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
note: John had more to say but preferred talking face to face over ink and pen.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to _____.
verse: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
note: Jesus' mission statement on the Mount: he came to fill the Law and the Prophets full, not to tear them down.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To the Lord our God belong mercies and _____, though we have rebelled against him;
verse: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
note: Daniel's great prayer: we rebelled, yet to God belong 'mercies and forgivenesses' — plural, because one would never be enough.
